title: Attendee Guide | Oct 17 Beijing AIGC Application Summit & AIGC100 Awards
summary: Unique Capital’s flagship industry gathering — AIGC Application Development Summit & AIGC100 Annual Awards — opens Thursday Oct 17 in Beijing. 50+ top AI founders via keynotes, panels, hands-on workshops, interactive exhibits, podcast marathon, and dinner party. Live stream
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Event · October 16, 2024 · Host: Unique Capital

Unique Capital’s flagship industry gathering — AIGC Application Development Summit & AIGC100 Annual Awards — opens Thursday Oct 17 in Beijing. 50+ top AI founders via keynotes, panels, hands-on workshops, interactive exhibits, podcast marathon, and dinner party. Live stream available for remote attendees.

When & where

Time: Thu Oct 17, 2024 · 09:00–18:00 (check-in from 08:30)
Venue: Beijing Vision International Hotel (CTS Tower) · 2 East Beisanhuan Rd, Chaoyang, Beijing

Weather: light rain → cloudy — dress warm.

Transit

  • Metro Line 10 · Sanyuanqiao · ~8 min walk
  • Capital Airport → Airport Express to Sanyuanqiao (~35 min) + walk
  • Beijing South → Line 14 Shilihe → Line 10 Sanyuanqiao (~45 min) + walk

Venue map

  • AI Summit Stage — Grand Ballroom (main forum)
  • Sponsor Hall — outside main hall; all-day booths; unlimited bottled water
  • Braindates Lounge (VIP) — VIP hall; all-day brain-dating + speaker holding
  • Podcast Room — Multi-function B; keep quiet
  • Workshop Room — Multi-function E; mini-program signup; approved attendees only
  • Founders Lounge (VIP) — Multi-function F; brain-dating + VIP lunch/dinner

Check-in & entry

Show the【entry ticket】inside the UniqueBloom mini-program; staff verify and issue badge. Check-in 08:30–09:00 at left of ballroom entrance — show 4-digit verification code or last 4 phone digits. Confirm name/company/title on badge immediately; wear all day. Arrive by 08:00 if possible to avoid queues; main forum starts 09:00 sharp.

No bottled water inside ballroom — get from booth area. Limited simple lunch ~12:00 at exhibitor booths (first come); no midday break. Closed spaces check badges; yellow zones = VIP only. Staff in black uniforms for help.

Full guest agenda in CN images (~5) — attach on import.

— END —
